title: jmap_handler: session_state stale by the time response is built
description: lib.rs jmap_handler reads session_state (combined_state) BEFORE dispatch (line 141-147). The dispatch may mutate the store (e.g. Message/set). The JmapResponse's sessionState field should reflect the state AFTER the mutation so clients can track changes. Reading before dispatch means the returned sessionState is always one step behind. RFC 8620 §3.4 requires sessionState to be the state at the time the response is constructed. Fix: read combined_state after dispatch completes, not before.
